items: The night wood is blue-green again, not lavender: the moonlight on the treetops and open ground is paler
Dark crowns and rock spires no longer show a grid of bright dots in the moonlight; faded tree trunks fade in soft clusters
In the bold and ref art styles the witch now stands out in her own light
A partied area's ground glows warm amber again; its neon colour stays on the bulbs and the soundsystem
